jobs.raw_description:
Full Stack Engineer (Next.js, React, Python, AI & Marketing Tech) – Remote | EST Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours – EST

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients — a fast-growing marketing agency serving 150+ home service businesses — is hiring a hands-on Full Stack Engineer to build internal tools, marketing technology, AI-powered workflows, and automation systems.

This is a builder role, not a strategy-only position.

You’ll work directly across:

  • Full-stack application development
  • Marketing data and attribution
  • Meta Pixel & Conversion API (CAPI)
  • CRM integrations and automation
  • AI-powered marketing workflows
  • Internal dashboards and reporting tools

You’ll collaborate closely with leadership, media buyers, and operators to turn operational challenges into production-ready systems that directly improve campaign performance, lead conversion, and efficiency.

What You’ll Own

Full Stack & Internal Tool Development

  • Build and deploy production-ready internal tools using:
    • Next.js
    • React
    • Python
  • Develop:
    • Marketing dashboards
    • Reporting systems
    • Internal operational tools
    • Workflow automation
  • Replace repetitive manual processes with scalable software solutions
  • Build reliable systems used directly by media buyers and operational teams

Marketing Tracking, Data & Attribution

  • Implement and optimize:
    • Meta Pixel
    • Meta Conversion API (CAPI)
  • Manage:
    • Event tracking
    • Event deduplication
    • Conversion attribution
    • Offline conversion syncing
  • Build data pipelines connecting:
    • Ad platforms
    • Backend systems
    • CRMs
    • Reporting dashboards
  • Ensure campaign data remains accurate and actionable
  • Support reporting across metrics such as:
    • ROAS
    • CPL
    • CAC
    • Conversion rates
    • Lead quality

CRM & Lead Lifecycle Automation

  • Build integrations with CRM platforms such as:
    • GoHighLevel
    • Close CRM
    • HubSpot
    • Similar platforms
  • Connect the full lead lifecycle:
    • Lead capture
    • CRM entry
    • Lead routing
    • Follow-ups
    • Pipeline progression
    • Conversion tracking
  • Build automations using APIs and webhooks
  • Sync CRM outcomes back to advertising platforms for attribution and optimization
  • Maintain data consistency across CRM, marketing, and reporting systems

AI Integration & Automation

  • Integrate AI into real-world marketing workflows
  • Work with APIs such as OpenAI and similar AI platforms
  • Build AI-powered systems for:
    • Ad copy generation
    • Creative generation workflows
    • Lead scoring
    • Lead qualification
    • Campaign analysis
    • Automated reporting and insights
  • Embed AI capabilities into production marketing and operational systems
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work through intelligent automation

Rapid Development & Iteration

  • Ship working solutions quickly and iterate based on real-world usage
  • Work directly with media buyers to identify campaign bottlenecks
  • Troubleshoot technical issues affecting:
    • Tracking
    • Attribution
    • CRM workflows
    • Reporting
    • Lead conversion
  • Continuously improve internal systems based on campaign data and team feedback

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • 4–6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience
  • Strong full-stack development experience with:
    • React
    • Next.js
    • Python
  • Proven experience building and deploying production-level applications or internal tools
  • Strong experience with:
    • APIs
    • Webhooks
    • System integrations
    • Automation workflows
  • Active use of AI tools in day-to-day engineering work
  • Hands-on experience in a marketing, advertising, or ad-tech environment
  • Experience with Meta Pixel and/or Conversion API (CAPI), including:
    • Event tracking
    • Deduplication
    • Attribution
  • Experience building marketing dashboards or reporting systems
  • Hands-on CRM integration experience with platforms such as:
    • GoHighLevel
    • Close
    • HubSpot
  • Experience automating:
    • Lead capture
    • Lead routing
    • Pipeline management
    • Conversion tracking
  • Experience connecting advertising platforms with CRM systems for attribution and reporting
  • Strong builder mindset with a bias toward execution

Nice to Have

  • Performance marketing agency experience
  • Experience supporting high-volume paid advertising campaigns
  • Understanding of:
    • ROAS
    • CPL
    • CAC
    • Conversion rates
    • Lead quality
  • Experience with:
    • Zapier
    • Make
    • Similar automation platforms
  • Understanding of marketing data pipelines
  • Familiarity with attribution challenges related to:
    • iOS privacy changes
    • Browser tracking limitations
    • Server-side tracking
  • Experience developing AI-powered internal tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re an engineer who enjoys building and shipping, not just planning architecture
  • You understand both software engineering and the realities of performance marketing
  • You know how marketing data moves between ad platforms, backend systems, and CRMs
  • You can troubleshoot attribution and tracking problems
  • You’re comfortable integrating APIs and automating complex workflows
  • You actively use AI to improve engineering speed and business processes
  • You can work directly with non-technical teams such as media buyers and marketers
  • You move quickly without sacrificing reliability

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start by reviewing tracking data and investigating an attribution discrepancy between Meta Ads and the CRM.

Later, you could build a new Next.js dashboard for media buyers, implement a Python service that scores incoming leads using AI, or create a webhook integration that sends CRM conversion outcomes back through Meta CAPI.

You’ll work closely with media buyers and leadership to identify bottlenecks, build solutions, deploy them, and iterate based on real campaign performance.

In short: you build the technology connecting advertising, CRM, AI, data, and operations — helping the agency run faster and make better marketing decisions.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Internal tools actively adopted by media buyers and operators
  • Accurate Meta Pixel/CAPI tracking and attribution
  • Reliable CRM and advertising-platform data synchronization
  • Reduction in manual marketing and operational workflows
  • Faster campaign reporting and execution
  • Improved lead tracking and conversion visibility
  • Successful deployment of AI-powered workflows
  • Reliability and scalability of production systems

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Build technology directly tied to marketing performance and revenue
  • Work across software engineering + AI + ad tech
  • High ownership over internal products and systems
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and performance marketing teams
  • Opportunity to build AI systems used in real production workflows
  • Work with marketing operations supporting 150+ home service businesses
  • Fully remote environment with significant autonomy

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you’re a Full Stack Engineer with strong React, Next.js, and Python skills who has hands-on experience with marketing technology, Meta CAPI, CRM integrations, attribution, and AI-powered automation, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and build systems that directly improve campaign performance, lead conversion, and operational efficiency.
